questions.q: Q₁ = 20 and Q₃ = 32. Above what value is a data value an outlier?
questions.why: IQR = 12, so the upper limit is Q₃ + 1.5 × IQR = 32 + 18 = 50.

questions.q: A distribution has Q₁ = 12, median = 15 and Q₃ = 24. Describe its skewness.
questions.why: Q₃ − Q₂ = 9 is greater than Q₂ − Q₁ = 3, so it is positively skewed.

questions.q: A cumulative frequency graph shows 120 values. At what cumulative frequency do you read the 90th percentile?
A distribution has mean 42, median 38 and mode 35. Describe its skewness and give a reason.
questions.model: Positive skew, because mean > median > mode.
